preparation.enabled: One README-mapped XLSX product/order-line sheet with repeated order headers; optional separately declared unit-conversion lookup omitted because line net revenue and count do not require conversions.
preparation.money: Native XML numeric tokens use decimal dot; text uses source-column convention evidenced by unambiguous summary formatting. Summary rows are excluded from transaction facts/sums.
preparation.roles: Explicit one-product-per-row README permits separately priced Topping sale rows in this XLSX shape; vouchers/fees/unknown roles still block dependent metrics.
preparation.status_aliases: Đã hoàn hàng = returned; Đang giao dịch = recorded active/noncancel/nonreturn for revenue/count. Raw status preserved; this is not evidence of physical shipment for future shipping metrics.

policy.money_arithmetic: Exact Decimal; exact Fraction derived from Decimal for division; one output rounding.
policy.zero_or_negative_baseline: abstain; undefined/signed-baseline policy not established by authority
policy.coverage: Preflight each window independently; requested/effective bounds retained; no missing-to-zero conversion.

limitations: Only whole-business revenue percent_change with positive baseline, two windows, and verified existing contracts. Zero/negative baseline, undefined policy, unknown coverage or unresolved authority abstain; no guessed 0/infinity.
One transaction XLSX sheet only, no multi-sheet/JOIN/quantity/ranking/average/share expansion. CSV S1 and two-window difference remain under regression.

8 common-dev native questions, 6 not inspected/used for this implementation before selection plus 2 already exposed; historical EDA/streaming exposure declared. Selected development slice, not representative PA or blind evaluation.
Two fresh CUDA workers, same predictions; host load/cache not controlled. Only GTX 1650, 29 layer offload, not Blackwell or CPU model certification.
Finite labels/regex/time/scope guards are not general Vietnamese or full-document policy comprehension. Internal evaluator official equivalence remains unverified.
All 15 synthetic behavior cases reported; only 11 have determined gold. Four unknown/undefined/ambiguous cases are behavior diagnostics with no placeholder scoring labels.
